principal.check: no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL/EXECUTE/GRANT privilege in USER_SYS_PRIVS, USER_TAB_PRIVS, USER_ROLE_PRIVS (resolved through ROLE_*_PRIVS) or SESSION_PRIVS; INHERIT PRIVILEGES on the principal itself is Oracle's default self-grant

dictionary_views.note: ALL_* only lists objects the principal holds object privileges on (SELECT ANY TABLE covers tables/indexes, nothing else); DBA_* is readable through SELECT ANY DICTIONARY. Both are plain read-only dictionary reads.

buckets.migrate: Data is carried into the Atlas migration database as collection documents and reconciled under migration/billing/tolerances.json (exact match, row-diff 0).
buckets.migrate-as-logic: Behaviour is re-implemented in the billing service (no Oracle object is carried); parity is proven by the repo's procs/harness transcripts, not by row recon.
buckets.retire: Not carried and not re-implemented as code; any surviving requirement is noted and met by a MongoDB-native feature (ObjectId keys, TTL index).
buckets.out-of-scope: Not part of the billing estate (fixture plumbing or unrelated); excluded from migration and recon.

objects.name: JOB_NIGHTLY_DUNNING
objects.note: 02:00 daily: pkg_dunning.sp_schedule_dunning + sp_suspend_overdue; becomes a scheduled job in the billing service. Created DISABLED in the estate.

objects.name: JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG
objects.note: 03:30 daily DELETE of BILLING_AUDIT_LOG older than 90 days with EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; the retention requirement is met by a TTL index on logged_at (expireAfterSeconds = 90 days), the swallowed-error path is dropped.

objects.name: PKG_DUNNING
objects.note: Entrypoints fn_overdue_accounts, sp_schedule_dunning, sp_suspend_overdue; invoked nightly by JOB_NIGHTLY_DUNNING.

objects.name: PKG_INVOICING
objects.note: Entrypoints fn_invoice_preview, fn_invoice_lines, sp_issue_invoice; depends on PKG_RATING and PKG_OW_UTIL (ALL_DEPENDENCIES).

objects.name: PKG_OW_UTIL
objects.note: f_md5_uuid, f_code_desc (EXECUTE IMMEDIATE lookup), f_dt2str/f_str2dt (DD-MON-YY round-trips), log_msg (autonomous-transaction logger); package-state globals g_call_count/g_last_module/g_last_uuid are dropped.

objects.name: PKG_PLANS
objects.note: Entrypoints fn_list_plans, fn_entitlement, sp_change_plan (README 'Entrypoint mapping'); parity via procs/harness.

objects.name: PKG_RATING
objects.note: Entrypoints fn_usage_rating, fn_usage_summary, sp_finalize_rating; rating state in package globals between compute and finalize.

objects.name: SEQ_BILLING_AUDIT_LOG
objects.note: Synthetic key generator; existing log_id values travel as data, new documents use ObjectId.

objects.name: SEQ_CUSTOMER_MASTER
objects.note: Feeds CUSTOMER_MASTER.cust_seq_no (starts at 100000); existing values travel as data with the table.

objects.name: SEQ_CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST
objects.note: Synthetic key generator for CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST.hist_id.

objects.name: SEQ_ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE
objects.note: Synthetic key generator for ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE.eav_id (CACHE 1000).

objects.name: SEQ_SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST
objects.note: Synthetic key generator for SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST.hist_id.

objects.name: BILLING_AUDIT_LOG
objects.note: Audit records written by pkg_ow_util.log_msg (autonomous transaction, packages/01_pkg_util.sql:67); carried as an audit collection with a TTL index on logged_at replacing JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG's 90-day purge.

objects.name: CODES
objects.note: Generic lookup that decodes every magic-number *_CD column (README: 'magic-number *_CD statuses resolved through the generic CODES table'); carried so historical codes still decode.

objects.name: CREDIT_NOTES
objects.note: amount/remaining_amount under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: CUSTOMER_MASTER
objects.note: 155-column denormalized master (ADDR_LINE_1..6, PHONE1..4, FLAG_01..20, UDF_01..40, DD-MON-YY text dates, CSV id lists); all *_amt columns under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST
objects.note: Full-row-copy history maintained by TRG_CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST; listed in migration/billing/tolerances.json money columns, so it is recon scope.

objects.name: ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE
objects.note: EAV dumping ground typed as strings; carried (natural fit for embedded attributes), keyed by eav_id.

objects.name: FIXTURE_META
objects.note: Fixture bootstrap/health marker written by the Oracle Free startup orchestrator; no package, trigger or job references it (ALL_DEPENDENCIES), it is not billing data.

objects.name: INVOICES
objects.note: subtotal/tax/total under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: INVOICE_HEADER
objects.note: total_amt under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: INVOICE_LINE
objects.note: Bulk mainframe-conversion feed with an unenforced pointer at INVOICE_HEADER (planted orphans are compared as a set per tolerances.json); qty/unit_price/amount/tax_amt under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: INVOICE_LINES
objects.note: Transactional lines used by pkg_invoicing; distinct from the bulk INVOICE_LINE feed.

objects.name: PLANS
objects.note: Money columns monthly_fee/overage_rate are under exact-decimal recon (migration/billing/tolerances.json).

objects.name: RATING_RESULTS
objects.note: overage_amount under exact-decimal recon.

objects.name: SUBSCRIPTIONS
objects.note: Core subscription state; its two business-rule triggers are bucketed separately.

objects.name: SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST
objects.note: Full-row-copy history maintained by TRG_SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST; existing history rows are carried, the copying rule is migrate-as-logic.

objects.name: TENANTS
objects.note: Shared across namespaces: 9 baseline rows (schema/03_seed_static.sql:9-18) plus 60 per demo namespace named '<ns>::tenant-*'; the ns slice is selected with name LIKE '<ns>::%'.

objects.name: USAGE_EVENTS
objects.note: Rating input; validation lives in TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK (migrate-as-logic).

objects.name: TRG_BILLING_AUDIT_LOG_ID
objects.note: Pure key assignment from SEQ_BILLING_AUDIT_LOG (README 'Sequences + triggers instead of identity columns').

objects.name: TRG_CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST
objects.note: AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE 155-column full-row copy into CUSTOMER_MASTER_HIST; becomes application-side versioning.

objects.name: TRG_CUSTOMER_MASTER_SEQ
objects.note: Derives cust_name_upper and defaults row_version_no on insert (logic kept); the seq_customer_master assignment part is retired with the sequence.

objects.name: TRG_ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE_SEQ
objects.note: Pure key assignment from SEQ_ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE.

objects.name: TRG_SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST
objects.note: AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE full-row copy into SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST with a text timestamp; becomes application-side versioning.

objects.name: TRG_SUB_NO_UNCANCEL
objects.note: Business rule in a trigger: status_cd 30 (cancelled) can never change; becomes a service-layer invariant.

objects.name: TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK
objects.note: Validation in a trigger: units > 0 and kind_cd present in CODES('USAGE_KIND'); becomes service/schema validation.
